infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Campaign Agent to access your camera to photograph the result form as required evidence for election result submissions.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow Campaign Agent to record your GPS location when submitting results to verify your presence at the polling station.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Campaign Agent to access your photo library to attach result form photos.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Campaign Agent to use Face ID so you can sign in quickly without typing your password on election day.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Campaign Agent to access your photos to attach result form images.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Campaign Agent to access your camera to photograph the result form.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Campaign Agent to record your location when submitting election results.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Campaign Agent to record your GPS location for result submission verification.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Campaign Agent to use Face ID so you can sign in quickly without typing your password on election day.
